value.canary: Aligned uniform sources remain destination-bijection negative anchors; scrambling preparation labels must not preserve paired distributions by construction.

claim.claim: For the tested semantic1 ensemble family, effective next-support probability is induced by the declared microstate preparation measure and a deterministic branch-union law (incoming destinations, surviving incumbents, and XNOR births where present), not by support alone.
claim.metric: exact predicted next support in every fresh binary trial; at least 6/8 uniform-vs-clustered pairs TV>0.05
claim.threshold: all binary trials exact and measure sensitivity gate passes
